title: When searching is trying to prove enoughness
subtitle: For the quest that is secretly asking to be validated
description: These readings separate honest seeking from the ache to justify yourself, then return dignity to grace and true wealth.

heroSource.shortMeaning: The mind’s wandering can hide a wound of worth; Naam gives the search a truer treasure.
heroSource.lifeApplication: Seek because truth is worthy, not because you must prove you are.

evidence.coreClaim: This path exposes the self-worth wound that can hide inside constant seeking.
evidence.turn: The search becomes freer when it no longer has to manufacture dignity.
evidence.practicalImplication: Let one act of remembrance be enough without turning it into evidence for your value.
